faq.q: What is the 2027 numerology report price in India?
faq.a: The Astro-Numero Blend is ₹1,263 (was ₹1,804) and the Classic is ₹963 (was ₹1,376), with the 30% Diwali offer until 6 November. Outside India they are US$30 and US$20.

faq.q: What is the difference between Astro-Numero Blend and Classic?
faq.a: Classic is a numerology report built from your name and date of birth. Astro-Numero Blend reads your numerology together with astrology from your birth chart, so it also needs your time of birth.

faq.q: Is this a generic yearly horoscope?
faq.a: No. Your Personal Year, Mulank, Lo Shu grid and Name Number come from your own date of birth and name, and Chapter 1 is written for your exact Personal Year and sun sign combination. Two people rarely get the same report.

faq.q: I don't know my time of birth. Can I still get it?
faq.a: Yes. Choose Classic. It is built from your date of birth and your name, so your birth time is not needed. The Astro-Numero Blend needs your time of birth.

faq.q: Is the 2027 numerology report a PDF, and when will I receive it?
faq.a: Yes. Your 2027 numerology report PDF arrives on your WhatsApp within 24 hours of payment. Inside is a QR code that opens a 30 to 60 second voice note from Shashank about your year.

faq.q: What is a 2027 astro numero report?
faq.a: It is a report that reads numerology and astrology together. Our 2027 astro numero report is the Astro-Numero Blend: your numbers read alongside your birth chart, which is why it needs your time of birth.

faq.q: Does it include a 2027 Lo Shu grid report?
faq.a: Yes. Every report has a 2027 Lo Shu grid report page: your date of birth plotted on the grid with your destiny number added and your 2027 Personal Year marked.
Buy your 2027 numerology report online on this page by UPI, card or netbanking. If you would like to talk first, message us on WhatsApp and pay from there.

faq.q: What if my report does not arrive?
faq.a: If your report has not reached you within 24 hours of payment, message us on WhatsApp with your payment reference. We send it straight away, or refund you in full if we cannot deliver it. The refund and delivery policy has the details.

faq.q: Can I order for my family or more than one person?
faq.a: Each order on this page is for one person, because each personalized 2027 numerology report is built from one date of birth. For two or more people, message us on WhatsApp and we will arrange it.

faq.q: How do I choose the best 2027 numerology report?
faq.a: Look for one built from your own date of birth and name rather than your sun sign alone, that shows how each number is worked out, reads every month of 2027 and tells you who prepared it. A detailed numerology report for 2027 should also give remedies you can act on.

faq.q: Is there a free 2027 numerology report?
faq.a: The Personal Year calculator on this page is free and tells you the number your year is read through. The full report, with every month, your dates, Lo Shu grid and voice note, is paid. You can also read free 2027 numerology predictions on our blog.

faq.q: Does it replace a full birth chart consultation?
faq.a: No. Your Mahadasha, Antardasha and Saturn cycles are read live in a separate consultation with Shashank. Ask on WhatsApp if you would like one.

faq.q: Why is phase one limited to 200 reports?
faq.a: Every report is prepared for one person by Shashank and his team. Phase one takes 200 reports and closes on 6 November.
